A '''shrapnel pistol''' was a ranged [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] used by the [[Ebruchi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ness (pirate)|Ness]], the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] of the [[Ebruchi (fleet)|Ebruchi fleet's]] [[Burning Gear (flotilla)|Burning Gear]] [[Fleet/Legends|flotilla]], possessed a sharpnel [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The shrapnel pistol was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
